method: Read the full cleaned text and every removed sentence for all eight sampled opinions; compare retained text by reconstruction. Two cases from each class in each development split.
rules: Becca full_v1 and masked_v2, unchanged before and after this audit

cases.note: Cross: affirmance and repeated proper grant removed; causation/speculation analysis, earlier trial grant and precedents retained.

Maus: affirmance and concluding proper denial removed; liquid/notice analysis and original trial denial retained. Concluding sentence also loses its Winegrad citation; minor Dillon, J. footer remains.
Williams: reversal and should-have-granted sentence removed; original denial, mat condition, inspection evidence and notice precedents retained.
Keum Ok Han: reversal and final should-have-granted sentence removed; out-of-possession reasoning, earlier denial and cited decisions retained.
Cheprakova: affirmance and final proper grant removed. Unlike the old trial mask, v2 retains the earlier ruling ending in Inc. Causation/speculation reasoning and precedents remain.
Luttenberger: affirmance and concluding approval removed; threshold facts, open-and-obvious reasoning, cited decisions and earlier trial ruling retained.

Zubillaga: both opening reversed orders removed; earlier default rulings and warning-sign reasoning retained. Ancillary current leave-to-appeal and briefing-motion results remain; this is not exhaustive removal of all procedural outcomes.

Yerry: reversal and final should-have-denied sentence removed. Unlike the old trial mask, v2 retains the evidentiary properly-considered ruling and its precedents. Notice/remedial reasoning and earlier trial grant remain; the removed final sentence still contains reasoning and a citation.

conclusion: All eight sampled whole-appeal dispositions were removed while substantial reasoning and historical decisions remained. Whole-sentence deletion still loses some reasoning/citations, and ancillary procedural outcomes can remain. This small assistant audit does not prove corpus-wide leakage elimination.
relation_to_team_review: This additional technical audit is separate from the user's confirmation that the team independently reviewed the underlying work today. It does not invent an additional human audit.
